messages.subject: Posting attachments to the forum
parts:
Hi,

I've noticed that there there's been a occasional comments over the
last couple months about not being able to post attachments to the
forum. I guess this question is raised when people try post messages
via the web interface. I don't think it is possible there. However, if
you instead send your message to the forum via email to the
mailinglist address, you should be able to add attachments. (Please
let me know if the latter does not work.)

Cheers,

Henrik
